name: Kogda Gasnut Ogni
source:
A desolate, abandoned world where nothing exists. Not a single ray of light can pierce through the eternal gray veil that hangs in the air. But I don't mind. On the contrary, I even find it quite mesmerizing, because each of the particles endlessly descending from the sky is unique. Unique not only in itself, but also in the path the wind takes to carry it to the ground. The trajectory of this whimsical fall—and that of thousands of other particles—will never repeat again... Isn't that amazing?

But what are they, really? That remains a mystery, just like so much else around me. For as long as I can remember, I’ve been in an endless search for fragments of the past that might wipe away this enigma and the strange, deadened stillness. And finally, after all this time, it feels like I’m on the right path.

I will create. I will craft life with my own hands, using whatever materials I can find. I will stir the longing and loneliness that weigh so heavily on us both. We will be alone no longer...
translation:
一个荒凉、被遗弃的世界，什么都不存在。没有一丝光线能够刺穿悬在空中的永恒的灰色面纱。但我不介意。相反，我什至觉得它很令人着迷，因为从天空中不断落下的每一个粒子都是独一无二的。不仅其本身独特，而且风将其带到地面的路径也独特。这种异想天开的坠落轨迹——以及数千个其他粒子的轨迹——永远不会再重复……这不是很神奇吗？

但它们到底是什么？这仍然是一个谜，就像我周围的许多其他事情一样。从我记事起，我就一直在无休止地寻找过去的碎片，这些碎片可能会消除这个谜团和奇怪的、死寂的寂静。最后，经过这么长时间，我感觉我走在正确的道路上。

我会创造。我将用我能找到的任何材料，用自己的双手创造生活。我将激起我们俩沉重的渴望和孤独。我们将不再孤单…
